title: AI lead research and scoring with Hot, Warm and Cold alerts
metaTitle: AI Lead Research and Scoring in n8n | Pixel2Tech
metaDescription: An n8n workflow where AI agents research each new lead with Perplexity, score it from 1 to 100, log it in Google Sheets and send Hot, Warm or Cold alerts.
summary: Two AI agents in n8n research a submitted company, score it from 1 to 100, save the result to a sheet and email the sales team a Hot, Warm or Cold alert.
overview: We built this workflow for a B2B software company that wanted every inbound lead researched and scored before a salesperson picked it up. A lead is submitted through an n8n form. A researcher agent uses OpenAI with two Perplexity tools to look up the company's website and LinkedIn page, and returns structured fields. A second agent scores the lead from 1 to 100 against the client's criteria. The record is appended to Google Sheets, and a router sends a Hot, Warm or Cold email alert through Gmail.
challenge: Without automation, sales reps spend the first part of every lead review on basic research: what the company sells, whether it is B2B, whether it has an API or an enterprise plan. That work is slow and inconsistent, and strong leads wait in the same queue as poor fits.
approach: The n8n form trigger collects the company and contact details. The researcher agent runs on an OpenAI chat model with memory and two Perplexity tools, one for the company website and one for LinkedIn. It returns the LinkedIn URL, domain, B2B or B2C market, lowest paid plan, latest case study, API availability, enterprise plan, free trial and up to five integrations, all through a structured output parser. The lead scoring agent, on a second OpenAI model, reads that research and returns a score from 1 to 100, again through a structured parser. A Google Sheets node appends the full record, and a Switch node routes by score to one of three Gmail nodes, each with its own alert template.
outcome: Each submitted lead now arrives in the sales inbox already researched and scored, labeled Hot, Warm or Cold, with the same fields every time. The Google Sheet works as a running log of every lead and its score.

process.title: Define the scoring criteria
process.body: We agreed with the client which company traits signal a good fit, such as B2B focus, API access and an enterprise plan.

process.title: Build the research agent
process.body: We set up the Perplexity tools and a fixed output structure so every lead returns the same fields.

process.title: Build scoring and routing
process.body: We wrote the scoring agent prompt, set the Hot, Warm and Cold thresholds and wrote the three alert emails.

process.title: Test on sample leads
process.body: We ran test companies through the workflow and tuned prompts until scores and fields were consistent.

whyItMatters: Research done the same way for every lead gives sales a fair comparison and a faster start on the best fits.

faqs.q: Can the scores go into our CRM instead of a sheet?
faqs.a: Yes. The Google Sheets step can be swapped for HubSpot, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel or another CRM node, and the alerts can go to Slack instead of email.

faqs.q: Can you build something similar for my business?
faqs.a: Yes. We adapt the research fields, scoring rules and alerts to your market and tools. After a short call we send a fixed quote.
